## Battle of Cumae

Battle of Cumae may refer to:
*Battle of Cumae (524 BC), land battle between Cumae and Etruscans
*Battle of Cumae (474 BC), naval battle between Syracuse and Etruscans
*, land battle between Cumae and Carthage
*, naval battle of the Roman civil war
